Sabse calm log best act karte hain.
Chuppi sabse zor ki cheekh hai.
Jab sab haar maan lein, tabhi asli grit dikhta hai.
Taqat khamoshi mein badhti hai.
Darpok baar baar marte hain.
Courage hamesha roar nahi karta; kabhi whisper karta.
Sabse strong jawab restraint hai.
Khamoshi sona hai.
Bahadur hona: afraid hoke bhi move.
Himmat har jagah himmat ko bulati hai.
Khamoshi woh pause hai jo heal karta.
Jo aadmi pahad hila deta hai, woh chhote chhote pathar uthakar shuru karta hai.
Taqat jeet se nahin aati.
Grit abhedya hai.
Himmat darr ka samna karne ki shakti hai.
Grit dar ko aage badhne ki rawani banata.
Har experience se strength, courage, confidence milta hai.
Silence folly ke against ek fence hai.
Failure se mat dar; effort na karne se dar.
Himmat matlab jo sahi, woh karna.
Grit ka matlab apne kal ke liye tike rehna.
